note: Y7 Spring Block 1 Graphing data: one set of templates per small step of the White Rose Maths scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books read each day. How many books were read on Tuesday?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books read each day. How many more books were read on Thursday than on Monday?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books read each day. How many symbols are needed to show [[key * s]] books?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books read each day. (a) How many books were read altogether? (b) On Friday [[c3 + c4]] books were read. How many symbols are needed to show this? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S2 Bar charts
templates.text: The bar chart shows the favourite sport of some pupils. How many pupils chose rugby?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S2 Bar charts
templates.text: The bar chart shows the favourite sport of some pupils. How many more pupils chose tennis than hockey?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S2 Bar charts
templates.text: The bar chart shows the favourite sport of some pupils. How many pupils were asked altogether? What is the modal sport?
templates.answer: [[v1 + v2 + v3 + v4]] pupils; [[v1 == max(v1, v2, v3, v4)|if:Football/]][[v2 == max(v1, v2, v3, v4)|if:Rugby/]][[v3 == max(v1, v2, v3, v4)|if:Tennis/]][[v4 == max(v1, v2, v3, v4)|if:Hockey/]]

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S2 Bar charts
templates.text: The bar chart shows the favourite sport of some pupils. (a) How many pupils were asked? (b) What fraction chose hockey? Write your answer in its simplest form. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S3 Dual bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. How many girls bought a lunch on Tuesday?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S3 Dual bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. On Wednesday, how many more boys than girls bought a lunch?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S3 Dual bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. How many pupils bought a lunch on Monday? Which day had the most girls?
templates.answer: [[b1 + g1]] pupils; [[g1 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Monday/]][[g2 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Tuesday/]][[g3 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Wednesday/]]

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S3 Dual bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. (a) How many boys bought a lunch altogether? (b) How many more girls than boys bought a lunch altogether? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S4 Composite bar charts
templates.text: The composite bar chart shows how many boys and girls bought a school lunch. How many pupils bought a lunch on Tuesday?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S4 Composite bar charts
templates.text: The composite bar chart shows how many boys and girls bought a school lunch. How many girls bought a lunch on Monday?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S4 Composite bar charts
templates.text: The composite bar chart shows how many boys and girls bought a school lunch. On which day did the most pupils buy a lunch, and how many was that?
templates.answer: [[(b1 + g1) == max(b1 + g1, b2 + g2, b3 + g3)|if:Monday/]][[(b2 + g2) == max(b1 + g1, b2 + g2, b3 + g3)|if:Tuesday/]][[(b3 + g3) == max(b1 + g1, b2 + g2, b3 + g3)|if:Wednesday/]]: [[max(b1 + g1, b2 + g2, b3 + g3)]]

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S4 Composite bar charts
templates.text: The composite bar chart shows how many boys and girls bought a school lunch. (a) How many pupils bought a lunch on the three days altogether? (b) What fraction of them were boys? Give your answer in its simplest form. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S5 Coordinates in the first quadrant
templates.text: Write down the coordinates of point A.

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S5 Coordinates in the first quadrant
templates.text: Write down the coordinates of points A and B.

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S5 Coordinates in the first quadrant
templates.text: A and B are two corners of a rectangle with sides parallel to the axes. A is ([[ax]], [[ay]]) and B is ([[bx]], [[ay]]). The rectangle has height [[hh]]. Write down the other two corners.

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S5 Coordinates in the first quadrant
templates.text: A is ([[ax]], [[ay]]) and B is ([[bx]], [[by]]). (a) What is the distance from A to B in the x-direction? (b) Find the coordinates of the midpoint of AB. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S6 Scatter graphs
templates.text: The scatter graph shows revision time and test score for 8 pupils. What score did the pupil who revised for [[k]] hours get?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S6 Scatter graphs
templates.text: The scatter graph shows revision time and test score for 8 pupils. How many pupils revised for more than [[k]] hours?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S6 Scatter graphs
templates.text: The scatter graph shows revision time and test score (out of [[ymax]]) for 8 pupils. Describe how the test score changes as revision time increases.
templates.answer: As the hours of revision go up, the test score goes up

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S6 Scatter graphs
templates.text: The scatter graph shows revision time and test score for 8 pupils. (a) Estimate the score of a pupil who revised for 5 hours. (b) Pupil X revised for 9 hours. Explain why you should not use the graph to predict X's score. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) about [[m * 5 + c]]  (b) 9 hours is outside the range of the data (1 to 8 hours)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S7 Correlation
templates.text: What type of correlation does the scatter graph show?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S7 Correlation
templates.text: The scatter graph shows the age and value of used cars (a new car is worth about £[[c * 100]]). Describe the correlation and say what it means.
templates.answer: Negative correlation: the older the car, the lower its value

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S7 Correlation
templates.text: A scatter graph shows height (x, about [[h]] cm) and arm span (y). The points lie close to a straight line sloping up. Describe the correlation. Does it prove that a longer arm span causes extra height? Explain.
templates.answer: Strong positive correlation. No: correlation does not prove one thing causes the other

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S7 Correlation
templates.text: A shop owner plots the temperature (x) and the number of ice creams sold (y) each day. The points slope upwards. (a) What type of correlation is this? (b) Predict whether sales on a [[t]]°C day will be higher or lower than on a [[t - 6]]°C day. (2 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S8 Lines of best fit
check: m * k + c - c == m * k
templates.text: The scatter graph shows a line of best fit. Use the line to estimate the test score for a pupil who revised for [[k]] hours.

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S8 Lines of best fit
templates.text: Use the line of best fit to estimate how many hours of revision gives a test score of [[m * k + c]].

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S8 Lines of best fit
templates.text: The line of best fit passes through (0, [[c]]) and (9, [[9 * m + c]]). By how much does the score rise for each extra hour of revision, according to the line?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S8 Lines of best fit
templates.text: The graph shows a line of best fit. (a) Estimate the score for [[k]] hours of revision. (b) Is it sensible to use the line to estimate the score for [[k + 8]] hours? Explain. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) [[m * k + c]]  (b) No: [[k + 8]] hours is outside the range of the data

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S9 Time series graphs
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the temperature in month [[k]]?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S9 Time series graphs
calc: max(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the highest temperature, and in which month did it happen?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S9 Time series graphs
where: max(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6) > min(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the range of the temperatures?

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S9 Time series graphs
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. (a) Between which two months was the biggest rise? (b) What was the rise? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S10 Non-linear relationships
templates.text: The graph shows y = x² + [[c]]. Read off the value of y when x = [[k]].

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S10 Non-linear relationships
templates.text: The points (0, [[c]]), (1, [[c + 1]]), (2, [[c + 4]]), (3, [[c + 9]]) lie on a graph. Is the graph a straight line? Explain.
templates.answer: No: y goes up by 1, then 3, then 5, so the steps are not equal

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S10 Non-linear relationships
templates.text: Complete the table of values for y = x² + [[c]]: x = [[x1]], [[x2]], [[x3]].

templates.source: Y7 Spring B1 Graphing data · S10 Non-linear relationships
templates.text: A ball is dropped. Its distance fallen is d = [[a]]t² metres after t seconds. (a) Work out d when t = [[t1]]. (b) Is d proportional to t? Explain using t = [[t1]] and t = [[2 * t1]]. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) [[a * t1 * t1]] m  (b) No: doubling t from [[t1]] to [[2 * t1]] makes d go from [[a * t1 * t1]] to [[a * 4 * t1 * t1]], which is 4 times as much, not 2 times
